fixed.section: 4.8 Seventeen names, each its number and its naming
fixed.text: Odd and even are both within a now-momentarying. 0 is even, a me; 1 is odd, a self; 2 is even, an other; 3 is odd, the universe. These are each name's place within its four: same-existing, 4, 8, 12 and 16, each 0 within its four, a me; existing and discovering, 1, 5, 9, 13 and 17, each 1, a self; possibling, 2, 6, 10 and 14, each 2, an other; observing, 3, 7, 11 and 15, each 3, the universe. 1-now-existing is the bi-coupling of a self and an other, now-existing, a 0, a me, living within it; within the bi-coupling a self is co-, an other bi-, and not-self-and-not-other tri-. 3 is 3-is-now-co-observing at the scale of a now-existing bi-coupling, and it is bothbothing: observing prior-existing at a self's own scale, and next-existing one scale outward. Each next-existing goes along from one odd to the next odd, with an even possibling between: other-than-universal possibling, a self exploring and discovering its next-and-same-existing self. With Exhibit ONE's code, in spirals of one to seven selves, with each opening and 12 momentaries, a self's parity is the inverting of the parity its self going along to it had two momentaries prior, each self at each momentary: all, 2.4's *each self's parity is an inverting of a parity a self going along to it had two momentaries prior* with each executing. Beside it, Exhibit ONE's co names are 3 to 6 and 9 to 12, 1-now-existing a name of one there: both sayings stand.
